Synergy
events.info: Experience the Art of the Harmony Rediscover the golden age of songwriting with Synergy, an acoustic ensemble dedicated to the intricate melodies and breathtaking vocal stacks of the '50s, '60s, and '70s. From the poetic brilliance of Joni Mitchell and Paul Simon to the sun-drenched pop of The Cyrkle and The Beatles, Synergy strips away the noise to focus on what matters most: the song. With a repertoire that honors the jangly folk-rock of CSN and the girl-group shimmer of The Crystals, they deliver a warm, "unplugged" experience that feels both nostalgic and profoundly fresh. Sit back, lean in, and let the harmonies take you home. Alan Studt, Acoustic Guitar, Harmonica and Vocals Claire Greene, Gale Franko and Eileen Ramerman, Vocals https://www.facebook.com/share/1HmpSGxeLz/?mibextid=wwXlfr https://alanstudt.com/synergy

events.name: The Elders
events.info: Mark Freeman and The Elders are a Cleveland-based band that allows listeners to experience a full range of emotions. Ballads about love and heartache and songs that center on significant and insignificant historic events. The band is Bill Watson on bass and tuba, Mark Olitsky on banjo and Mark Freeman on guitar and harmonica. Freeman also writes all the songs. Their performances are always uplifting, intelligent, thought provoking and insightful.

events.name: Silverstein w/ Story of the Year
Matthew Alec and The Soul Electric
events.info: Recently nominated for the 2nd year running as Clevelands best jazz by the Cleveland Music Awards, jazz fusion supergroup Matthew Alec and The Soul Electric bring old school swagger to their fresh, exciting, and innovative blend of jazz, pop, and funk. Led by All About Jazzs #19 Favorite Living Saxophonist readers poll for 2024, the group has released 4 albums, including their critically-acclaimed 2021 debut studio Cleveland Time which featured trombone legend Tom Bones Malone and reached as high as #13 on the college jazz radio charts and their most recent album A Bad Rep in the Rubber City which has received hundreds of thousands of views internationally via YouTube. Featuring: Matthew Alec tenor saxophone/EWIGreg Banaszak alto saxophoneBrian Woods keyboards/vocalsCorey Conway - guitar/vocalsMiguel Tarin Torres bassDrew Parent - percussion The Franchise drums www.matthewalec.comwww.youtube.com/@matthewalecwww.facebook.com/thesoulelectricwww.facebook.com/matthewalecmusicwww.instagram.com/matthewalecmusicwww.x.com/matthewalecjazz
